user.title: Connect Hager flow
user.description: Choose how to reach the installation.

official.title: Official Hager Energy API
official.description: Request an OAuth client at {developer_portal_url}. Client ID and secret do not expire, so unlike the portal route this needs no periodic renewal.

data_description.client_secret: Treated like a password and stored with the config entry.

installation.title: Choose installation
installation.description: These credentials have access to more than one installation.

portal.title: Connect Hager flow
portal.description:
Sign in at {portal_url}, then open the browser developer tools (F12) and copy the value of `reAuthToken` from Application → Local Storage.

The serial number is shown in the portal title bar and in its URL.

data_description.serial: The 12-digit number shown in the portal
data_description.reauth_token: Valid for about 30 days. Home Assistant will ask for a new one when it expires.

reauth_official.title: Re-authenticate Hager flow
reauth_official.description: The client credentials for installation {installation_id} were rejected. Create a new OAuth client at {developer_portal_url} and enter it here.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Hager flow
reauth_confirm.description: The refresh token for installation {serial} has expired. Sign in at {portal_url} again and copy the current `reAuthToken` from Application → Local Storage.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Hager Energy cloud.
error.invalid_auth: The credentials were rejected. Please supply current ones.
error.unknown_serial: No installation found with this serial number.
error.no_installations: These credentials have access to no installation.

abort.already_configured: This installation is already set up.
